choices.en: yellow wind was hosting a feast.
choices.zh: 黄风正在举办一场宴会。

answer_evidence.quote: "I was sent to Earth as a punishment," said the pig.
"My name is Bajie. I caused trouble in Heaven too. Guanyin said I would be forgiven if I helped protect the Tang Monk."
"My master, the great king Yellow Wind, is hosting a feast," said the tiger.
Instead a tiger skin lay over a rock.
Wukong laughed. "He was so scared, he ran right out of his skin!"
